title: Journey
description: A use case for the catalog written so an agent can execute it. A journey names a persona, the moment it starts, the steps with the exact tool or command each one uses, and success criteria with a check an agent can perform. Steps the product cannot support yet are marked unavailable and point at a gap, so a run reports them as blocked instead of improvising. The execution protocol is docs/journeys/RUNNER.md.

id.description: Kebab-case id. Must equal the file name without .journey.json.

revised.description: Date this file was last changed in substance.

summary.description: One or two sentences: who does what and what they end up with.

status.description: works-today: every step is available and the baseline run met every success criterion. partial: runnable, but a step is unavailable or a criterion failed. not-built: the journey cannot be completed with what is shipped.

trigger.description: The moment the journey starts, in the persona's words where possible.

advantage.description: Why this journey is better here than with the alternatives in docs/research/landscape.md.

contracts.description: Patterns and constraint ids this journey names. Validated against the real contracts so a renamed constraint fails the gate instead of rotting here.

actor.description: persona: the human. agent: the persona's AI assistant. A runner plays both.

uses.description: The one mechanism this step may use. Required fields per kind are enforced by scripts/validate-journeys.mjs: mcp-tool needs tool and input; command needs run; read needs target and where; edit needs target, where and change; external needs name; judgment needs nothing.

where.description: repo: a path in this repository. workspace: a path in the run's scratch project. web: a URL.

optional.description: True when the journey still completes if this mechanism is not connected.

expect.description: What an observer would see if the step worked.

available.description: False when the product cannot support this step today. An unavailable step must name its gap.

gap.description: Id of the gap that blocks this step or makes it harder than it should be.

check.description: How an agent verifies the criterion: what to run or inspect and what counts as a pass.

evidence.description: What was observed, and where. A file path, a command and its result, or a link to a run report.

fix.description: The smallest change that would close the gap. A proposal, not a decision.

scope.description: in-scope: fits the hard scope limits in CLAUDE.md. owner-decision: touches a decision listed in docs/NORTH-STAR.md and must not be built before it is made.

decision.description: Required when scope is owner-decision: which decision.

runnable.description: full: an agent can execute every step unattended. partial: some steps are blocked or need something the runner may not have. spec-only: nothing to execute yet; run in plan mode.

workspace.description: scratch: the run creates a throwaway project outside this repository. none: the run only reads.

schedule.description: Suggested cadence for an unattended run.

report.description: Repo-relative path to the run report.
